items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: Wayne's brother Allan-- Super hit, Superfly--jumped up on the stage one night down at the Half Note

ctx.x: And just be so ready just jump up on

the stage--I met him one night, uh, Wayne's brother Allan-- Super hit, Superfly--jumped up on the stage one night down at the Half Note and that fool stood up there for about a half hour and he played nary a note. Standing up there trying to get ready to try and play something, you know, like if something like, somethings happening to the rhythm section or something he he go to put the horn up, getting ready to like he's...lead...make a face. I mean every- thing was drama, you know, so theatrics and he took the…

I said 'but how do you do that, you know, on a record date?' See he wasn't doing nothing but making disco bigger. See that's the same thing I was trying to say, tell you when I seen the laymen is sitting out there in the audience. Do you understand what I mean? So he's sitting out there and he's trying, you see, god damn man. See but now it could see. And the record sales, oh man see the jazz record sales was big man. Because they go and buy up all the records. They take their share home man. And so he would stay…
